Awad Capital provides services in a range of transactions, including mergers, acquisitions, business sales, and divestitures. Their sell side and divestiture advisory solutions include sell side process management, including sourcing of investors, valuations, preparation of marketing documentation, and deal negotiation and closing.

about_short_description.short_description: Awad Capital is a financial services firm that offers corporate finance and capital markets solutions.

product.name: Mergers and Acquisitions Advisory
product.description: Provides financial advisory services for mergers, acquisitions, sales, and divestments to corporations, investors, and entrepreneurs.

product.name: Capital Raising Advisory
product.description: Assists companies in raising growth or established capital by connecting them with suitable investors and managing the capital raising process.

product.name: Sell-Side Advisory Services
product.description: Advises clients on the sale of their businesses, including valuation, marketing, buyer identification, and transaction management.

product.name: Buy-Side Advisory Services
product.description: Offers advisory support to clients seeking to acquire businesses, including target identification, valuation, due diligence, and deal structuring.

product.name: Sector-Focused Advisory Services
product.description: Provides specialized advisory services tailored to specific industry sectors such as consumer, education, energy, financial services, healthcare, industrials, real estate, technology, and logistics.
